title: Schedule Important Relationships
coreMove: Give important people protected time before leftovers and urgent fragments consume the relationship by default.
sourcePressure: The chapter carries values-to-time logic into close relationships, protecting presence without measuring love by calendar volume.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would turn love into calendar math or generic advice to spend more quality time.

hook: Schedule Important Relationships as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.audience: sibling who lets logistics replace connection
exampleSpecs.stakes: medical updates crowd out the relationship itself
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she schedules a Sunday story call with no paperwork agenda and writes the first question on a note card
